description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity class named MyRssReader2 which is responsible for displaying RSS feeds in a list view. It includes methods for initializing the feed list, managing the activity lifecycle, and customizing list item views. It also contains an inner class RssDataAdapter for rendering the RSS items.

classes.name: MyRssReader2
classes.description: Main activity class for displaying RSS feeds in a list view, managing user interaction and activity state.

classes.name: MyRssReader2.RssDataAdapter
classes.description: Custom ArrayAdapter for rendering RSS items in the list view, highlighting unread items with bold-italic typeface.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, populates the list of RSS items, and binds the adapter to the list view.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the currently selected RSS list item index into the bundle to preserve UI state.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Creates the options menu with actions like start/stop service, add/delete feed, and update feeds.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares or updates the options menu before it is displayed.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles user selections from the options menu, triggering appropriate UI responses.

methods.name: initializeList
methods.description: Creates and returns a sample list of RssItem objects representing RSS feeds.
